front.prompt: Draw on this flat magenta canvas. Original creature design for a monster-collecting RPG, finished pixel art battle sprite in the style of Pokemon Black and White (Nintendo DS, 2010) opponent sprites. Strong readable silhouette, believable creature anatomy (real limbs, joints, paws or claws, a sense of weight), designed by a professional creature designer, NOT a cute mascot, NOT chibi, NOT kawaii: no blush marks, no sparkly anime eyes, eyes small and sharp with one tiny highlight. About 14 colors: 2-3 main hues with 3 shading tones each, dark colored outline (dark version of the local color, not pure black). Light from the upper left, flat clean shading areas, no dithering noise, no gradients, no anti-aliasing. Pose: three-quarter view turned to the LEFT, standing on its feet, head and chest facing left, tail on the right. NOT facing the viewer. Every art pixel is one clean square block of about 12x12 image pixels; the creature is about 80 art pixels wide. The whole background stays flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF: absolutely NO glow, NO aura, NO halo, NO embers, NO smoke, NO light bloom around the creature, no ground, no shadow, no text. Creature (normal/flying type, evolution stage 1): A small round fledgling bird standing on two sturdy legs with big three-toed feet: storm-grey wings still too small to fly, a cream-white puffed chest, a stiff sky-blue crest of three feathers swept back like a wind vane, a short pale-yellow beak, a stubby tail of two long feathers, leaning forward into the wind. Main colors: sky blue, storm grey, cream. It must NOT resemble any existing official monster, especially: Bulbasaur, Ivysaur, Charmander, Charmeleon, Squirtle, Leafeon, Eevee, Pidgey, Pidove, Torchic, Rowlet, Weedle, Caterpie, Wurmple, Venipede, Pikachu, Geodude, Rhyhorn, Wooloo, Diglett, Krabby, Horsea, Seadra, Zigzagoon, Totodile, Marill.
front.note: 2026-10-15 감독 위임 선택(사용자: 귀여운 걸로 감독이 전부 골라라)
